answer.response_raw: DMSO, or dimethyl sulfoxide, is used in a variety of ways both industrially and medically. Industrially, it is used as an antifreeze and a solvent for numerous chemicals. Medically, DMSO is applied to the skin as an anti-inflammatory and general pain reliever, most commonly for muscles and joints. It is also used to promote healing for minor cuts, burns, soft tissue damage, local tissue death, and skin ulcers. DMSO has the unique ability to penetrate skin and tissue, allowing it to enter the bloodstream.
